ResearchProjectDef.label: frontier commerce
ResearchProjectDef.description: Scales, a ledger, a lockable till and the habit of writing prices down. Everything needed to sell to passing strangers at a fixed price instead of haggling over every transaction.

ResearchProjectDef.label: stagecoach line
ResearchProjectDef.description: A standing arrangement with a coach line that already runs this stretch of road — someone else's horses, someone else's schedule, and a promise that a big-spending group won't miss the town for long. Nobody signs a stagecoach contract with a town that has nothing worth stopping for.
